svg.title: AIcoach — Landing, one thing per screen (r3-03)
svg.text: Film one swing down the line. AIcoach tells you the fault,
why it happens and what to practise, one calm step at a
time. Then you can ask it why.
For golfers between +2 and 15 handicap who practise at the range with a
phone. A practice tool, not for competitive rounds.

svg.text: Your coach is waiting for one swing.
Create an account, film a down-the-line clip, and read the answer at the range.
Your swing clips are private. Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool, not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
